name: GreenRocket

sources.title: Homepage — live React SPA 'The launchpad for the next generation of tech products' (Netlify + Supabase)

Official llms.txt — free community launch platform: register free, submit launches at /create, upvote-ranked feed, scheduled launches go live 12:00 AM UTC on launch date, sponsor slots via Stripe are separate

requirements: Free registration for 'builders' at /register (email/password or magic link)
A launch = name, tagline, description, URL, logo, screenshots, category, launch date — submitted via the authenticated /create wizard
Community-run ranking: 'No paid placement and no promoted slots' — position comes from upvotes (per their site copy)
Scheduled launches are publicly viewable immediately with a countdown and go live 12:00 AM UTC on the launch date
preparation: Product name, tagline, description, URL, logo, screenshots, category
A launch date — scheduling gets a T-24h reminder email plus a launch-day email and 'Launching Today' rail placement
Builder profile basics (bio, avatar, social links) — public profile at /@username feeds the Top Astronauts leaderboard
workflow: Open /create and fill the launch wizard (autosaves drafts for 14 days)
Pick a launch date — the launch goes live at 12:00 AM UTC that day; scheduled pages are publicly viewable beforehand with a countdown
Engage on launch day: reply to discussions, share via the multi-platform share menu
watchFor: Upvote-driven ranking means a dead launch day = dead listing — coordinate supporters for launch-day votes
Sponsor slots exist (/sponsors-ad, Stripe) but site copy says launches themselves are not pay-for-placement — don't pay expecting ranking
A Peerlist import exists (/peerlist) if your product is already on Peerlist — syncs projects + screenshot galleries
Cross-platform sync can push the launch to SoloStack.Space
SPA — forms require a JS-capable flow
countsAsLive: A public launch page at greenrocket.app/launch/<slug> exists (countdown if scheduled, LIVE NOW on launch day) and the launch appears on the /launches feed
unknowns: Whether outbound links are dofollow (search snippets claim 'real dofollow backlink' — unverified firsthand)
Moderation rules for what counts as a launch
